plugins.name: rcpair
plugins.description: Test your iOS app on a real iPhone or iPad from Claude Code: run, tap, type, scroll, read the screen and take screenshots on your own device. Pick up where Xcode and the simulator stop: real camera, notifications, sign-ins and speed. Works from Windows, Mac or Linux, no Mac needed.
